description.value:
Trigger Both Strikes from a single Crossbite land on the same Marked target

The wound opens ragged: it takes 1d6 persistent bleed damage (1d8 at Veteran tier, 1d10 at Undying), the crossing wounds still working after your turn ends.

cinderfall.incomplete: The Mark itself is now built (waywarden.mark-quarry.json grants TokenMark slug 'quarry'). This card's real blocker is independent: its trigger depends on Crossbite's own two-Strikes-as-one-attack shape, which is itself unbuilt (see waywarden.crossbite.json's note -- that resolution is hardcoded PF2e engine logic, not rule-element material). Also unbuilt regardless: the tiered escalation (1d8 at Veteran, 1d10 at Undying) -- those tier names are undefined anywhere in the corpus (see waywarden.vanish-between-blinks.json's note).
